reasonLabel: Reason (optional, shown to the other person)

farmer.title: Equipment rentals
farmer.subtitle: Rent tractors and other machines from approved owners. The owner confirms each booking.

find.emptyBody: Try another district or type. Only machines listed by approved owners are shown.

book.title: Book {{name}}
book.subtitle: Owner: {{owner}}. Your request is sent to the owner, who accepts or rejects it.
book.dayHint: Day bookings run from midnight to midnight, India time.
book.estimateHint: The final amount is calculated by the server from the owner's rate.
book.invalid: Choose a date, a start time and a duration (1–{{hours}} hours or 1–{{days}} days).
book.paymentHint: Pay the owner directly. TerraByte does not take payments.
book.busyTitle: Already booked in the next {{days}} days
book.busyNone: No bookings in the next {{days}} days.
book.done: Booking request sent. The owner will confirm it.

mine.emptyBody: Find a machine in the other tab and send a booking request.
mine.cancelBody: The owner will be notified and the time becomes free again.

equipment.title: My equipment
equipment.subtitle: Machines you rent out. Farmers see active machines in the rentals list.
equipment.empty: You have not listed any equipment yet.
equipment.emptyBody: Add a machine with its hourly or daily rate so farmers can book it.

form.description: Farmers see these details and rates when they book.
form.name: Name
form.rateHint: Give at least one rate. Leave a rate empty if you do not rent by that unit.
form.needRate: Give an hourly rate, a daily rate or both.

owner.title: Rental requests
owner.subtitle: Bookings of your equipment. Accept or reject requests and mark finished rentals as completed.
owner.emptyBody: Bookings appear here when farmers request your equipment.
owner.acceptBody: The farmer is notified and the time stays reserved for them.
owner.rejectBody: The farmer is notified and the time becomes free.
owner.completeBody: The amount is added to the farmer's farm accounts as an expense.
owner.completeLater: Can be marked completed once the booking has started.

calendar.title: Booking calendar
calendar.subtitle: Days on which each machine is requested, booked or was used (India time).
calendar.noEquipment: Add equipment first to see its calendar.
